name: TrueWood Lite American Walnut Slats, Black Felt
summary: Solid rubberwood slats wrapped in real American walnut veneer on three sides, stapled to a black acoustic felt backing.

texture.note: Manufacturer spec sheet dimensions override photo estimates: 8 slats, each 27 mm (1.063 in) wide with a 10.5 mm (0.413 in) square felt gap, on a 37.5 mm pitch; the tile spans the 300 mm installed panel width by 600 mm, with 5 mm slats over 5 mm felt (10 mm total). Muted American walnut tones and per-slat variation are sampled from the main listing photo; grain and black acoustic felt are synthesized periodically without baked lighting.
